abstract: The decisions of funding agencies greatly influence the direction of scientific research; however, our understanding of how applicants' research directions affect the selection process remains limited. In this study, we investigate how a project's coherence with a scientist's previous work and its alignment with current scientific trends affect the probability of winning a renowned research fellowship. Employing a neural network algorithm to compute these indicators, we analyze the text of 2494 research projects proposed by scholars competing for the Sloan Research Fellowship, one of the most prestigious fellowships for early‐career researchers in North America. Our findings reveal notable differences across fields in the effect of coherence and alignment on the probability of being awarded, reflecting distinct organizational norms. For instance, applicants with coherent and aligned projects have higher chances of winning in life sciences & chemistry. In contrast, in physics, bibliometric measures such as the number of publications and citations outweigh research direction characteristics in the selection process. This study aims to offer valuable insights into the factors influencing scientific selection processes, exhibiting how they shape the research landscape for early‐career scientists across various academic fields.
abstract_zh: 资助机构的决策极大地影响着科学研究的方向；然而，我们对于申请者的研究方向如何影响选拔过程的理解仍然有限。在本研究中，我们探讨了一个项目与科学家先前工作的一致性及其与当前科学趋势的契合度，如何影响获得著名研究奖学金的可能性。通过运用神经网络算法计算这些指标，我们分析了2494个由学者为竞争斯隆研究奖学金而提出的研究项目文本，该奖学金是北美早期职业研究者中最负盛名的奖学金之一。我们的发现揭示了不同领域中一致性和契合度对获奖概率影响的显著差异，反映了各自独特的组织规范。例如，在生命科学与化学领域，拥有连贯且契合项目的申请者获奖机会更高。相反，在物理学领域，诸如发表物数量和引用次数等文献计量指标在选拔过程中超过了研究方向特征的重要性。本研究旨在为影响科学选拔过程的因素提供有价值的见解，展示它们如何塑造不同学术领域中早期职业科学家的研究格局。
title: Research Direction and Science Evaluation: The Role of Coherence and Alignment
title_zh: 研究方向与科学评价：一致性与对齐的作用
